visualReview.notes: Inspected all ten current portable frames: preview, four turntable sides, lower and upper pearl, tripod base, spire capsule and distant silhouette. Silver caps, ruby panels, dark observation belts, three vertical columns, three inclined braces, seven inter-column tie levels and all eleven pearls are visible. Sphere panels have deliberate triangular surface articulation; support columns are smoothly shaded.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all ten current shared frames. Concrete and metal materials load through the shared library; colored sphere panels retain their local tint. Fine pane seams are continuous in the close views and the pale caps, ruby belts and dark observation glazing remain distinct. North-up map placement and unload fixtures pass.

geographicReview.notes: Anchor [121.49526040874795,31.241892490134386] and heading -0.3839563789705781 align the native frame with the cached footprint. Detailed mapped vertical column parts 520990194/520990195/520990196 establish the inner tripod on the opposite rays to the inclined braces. The north-up overlay shows the three outer brace-foot rays correctly placed. Ground Y0 follows host terrain; the modeled tower is separate from the surrounding park.

fidelityReview.notes: Detailed 288124-triangle reconstruction of the 468m tower exterior: three 9m columns, inclined 7m braces, concrete tie beams, eleven pearl volumes with individually modeled triangular panels and glazing belts, white/silver main-sphere caps, ruby cladding, central lift shaft, antenna shaft stages, maintenance platforms and rails. Primary engineering accounts and the Otis installed-project photograph establish the structural composition and color distribution. Secondary bay spacing, sphere belt proportions and small capsule details are reconstructed. Grounds, visitor approach walkways, interior rooms and broadcast equipment internals are outside this tower asset scope.
